  "domain_file": "(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips :adl)
  (:predicates (on ?x ?y) (on-table ?x) (clear ?x) (holding ?x) (arm-empty))

  ;; CONSTRAINT: At most three stacks at any time.
  ;; In Blocksworld, the number of stacks equals the number of on-table blocks.
  ;; Therefore the invariant is: no four distinct blocks may be on-table.
  ;; Putdown is the only action that increases the number of stacks, so it is
  ;; additionally restricted to states with at most two on-table blocks.

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and
      (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
      (not (exists (?s1 ?s2 ?s3 ?s4)
        (and
          (on-table ?s1) (on-table ?s2) (on-table ?s3) (on-table ?s4)
          (not (= ?s1 ?s2)) (not (= ?s1 ?s3)) (not (= ?s1 ?s4))
          (not (= ?s2 ?s3)) (not (= ?s2 ?s4)) (not (= ?s3 ?s4))))))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and
      (holding ?b)
      (not (exists (?s1 ?s2 ?s3)
        (and
          (on-table ?s1) (on-table ?s2) (on-table ?s3)
          (not (= ?s1 ?s2)) (not (= ?s1 ?s3)) (not (= ?s2 ?s3))))))
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b))))

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and
      (holding ?b) (clear ?c)
      (not (exists (?s1 ?s2 ?s3 ?s4)
        (and
          (on-table ?s1) (on-table ?s2) (on-table ?s3) (on-table ?s4)
          (not (= ?s1 ?s2)) (not (= ?s1 ?s3)) (not (= ?s1 ?s4))
          (not (= ?s2 ?s3)) (not (= ?s2 ?s4)) (not (= ?s3 ?s4))))))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c))))

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and
      (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
      (not (exists (?s1 ?s2 ?s3 ?s4)
        (and
          (on-table ?s1) (on-table ?s2) (on-table ?s3) (on-table ?s4)
          (not (= ?s1 ?s2)) (not (= ?s1 ?s3)) (not (= ?s1 ?s4))
          (not (= ?s2 ?s3)) (not (= ?s2 ?s4)) (not (= ?s3 ?s4))))))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c))
                 (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))))
",

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)

    :effect (and (not (holding ?b)) (clear ?b) (on-table ?b) (arm-empty))

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (on ?b ?c))
  )

  ;; CONSTRAINT: unstacking requires a clear block on top of another block and an empty arm.
  (:action unstack

    :effect (and (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (clear ?c) (holding ?b) (not (arm-empty)))

  (:predicates

    (on-table ?x - block)
    (clear ?x - block)
    (holding ?x - block)
    (arm-empty)
    ;; CONSTRAINT: above is the transitive stack relation used to maintain loads
    (above ?x - block ?y - block)
  )

    ;; CONSTRAINT: numeric load tracking
    (weight ?b - block)
    (load ?b - block)
  )

    :parameters (?b - block)
    :precondition (and (forall (?x - block) (>= (weight ?x) (load ?x)))
                       (on-table ?b)
                       (clear ?b)
                       (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))))

    :parameters (?b - block)
    :precondition (and (forall (?x - block) (>= (weight ?x) (load ?x)))
                       (holding ?b))

                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))))

                       (forall (?d - block)

                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))
                 (above ?b ?c)
                 (increase (load ?c) (weight ?b))
